title: Q: In the worked example, both methods agree — is checking both methods necessary, or is one sufficient?
notes: The a₁a₂ + b₁b₂ method alone is sufficient and is the standard fast method for exams — it requires no slope calculation or angle formula

The tan θ method is more computationally heavy but is useful as an independent verification, or when the a₁a₂ + b₁b₂ method feels error-prone (e.g. after a sign mistake while normalizing the constant terms)
In practice: use a₁a₂ + b₁b₂ to solve quickly, and only fall back to tan θ if you want to double-check a specific answer
